about.title: About HexaBlue
about.desc:
HexaBlue was founded by Flamey to build free, open-source software that solves everyday problems.
It is currently run solo, so new volunteers and contributors are always welcome!

project_overview.title: Featured Projects
project_overview.dibsy:
dibsy is a private, serverless social network.
Instead of a big tech company storing your data, everything is shared directly between people.
You get complete privacy and a highly customizable experience.
project_overview.seggs:
Server Eggs is a Discord bot made for sharing content ("Eggs") and discovering new communities along the way.
Have fun collecting as many Eggs as you can!

embed.description: See all the **projects** that we're working on, such as **dibsy** and **Server Eggs**!

dibsy.desc:
dibsy connects users directly to each other without relying on a central server.
Your data stays on your device and is shared peer-to-peer. For certain features, optional Pillars (which you can even self-host!) can provide useful services.
This setup ensures complete privacy, zero corporate control, and a space run entirely by its members.

seggs.desc:
Server Eggs lets your Discord community create and share content called "Eggs" containing text, media, or both.
Use it to promote your server, find new places to hang out, or have fun collecting Eggs (especially secret ones...) and battling friends!
